# bioERGOtech Foundation

> bioERGOtech is a Swiss-registered, internationally operating foundation dedicated to advancing Engineered Living Systems. We develop projects at the intersection of synthetic biology, AI-driven automation, and multi-omics analytics to accelerate the future of biomanufacturing and therapeutic innovation.

## About

The bioERGOtech Foundation was established to bridge the gap between cutting-edge scientific research and real-world biotechnology applications. We operate across three hubs: Taranto (Italy), Zurich (Switzerland), and Riyadh (Saudi Arabia).

Our work is organised around four scientific pillars:

1. **Digital Twin Therapeutics** — Computational models that simulate biological systems for personalised medicine and drug discovery.
2. **Synthetic Biology & Cell Engineering** — Designing and building new biological parts, devices, and systems for therapeutic and industrial use.
3. **Automated Biomanufacturing & Control** — AI-driven laboratory automation and closed-loop control systems for scalable bioprocessing.
4. **Integrated Multi-Omics Analytics** — Combining genomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and other -omics data for holistic biological understanding.
